title: Hook events: session lifecycle
description: Event arrays (`hookEvent_<Event>`) and matcher groups (`hookMatcherGroup_<Event>`) for: SessionStart, Setup, InstructionsLoaded, SessionEnd.

hookEvent_SessionStart.title: SessionStart
hookEvent_SessionStart.description: When a session begins or resumes. mcp_tool hooks are skipped at launch (MCP servers are not yet available) but run after /clear or compaction.

hookMatcherGroup_SessionStart.description: Matcher group for SessionStart: an optional matcher plus the handlers to run when it applies. Handlers allowed here: command or mcp_tool (http, prompt and agent hooks are not supported on this event). The `if` field is not evaluated on this event, so a handler that sets it never runs.

matcher.description: Filters on how the session started. Values: `startup`, `resume`, `clear`, `compact`, `fork`. Evaluation: `*`, an empty string, or an omitted matcher matches everything; a value made only of letters, digits, `_`, `-`, spaces, `,` and `|` is an exact string or a `|`/`,`-separated list of exact strings; any other character makes it an unanchored JavaScript regular expression (RegExp.test).
matcher.title: Matcher

hooks.description: Hook handlers to run when the matcher applies; all matching handlers run in parallel and identical handlers from several settings files run once.
hooks.title: Hooks

hookEvent_Setup.title: Setup
hookEvent_Setup.description: When Claude Code starts with `--init-only`, or with `--init` or `--maintenance` in `-p` mode. Only command hooks actually run: mcp_tool hooks are always skipped here.

hookMatcherGroup_Setup.description: Matcher group for Setup: an optional matcher plus the handlers to run when it applies. Handlers allowed here: command or mcp_tool (http, prompt and agent hooks are not supported on this event). The `if` field is not evaluated on this event, so a handler that sets it never runs.

matcher.description: Filters on the CLI flag that triggered setup. Values: `init`, `maintenance`. Evaluation: `*`, an empty string, or an omitted matcher matches everything; a value made only of letters, digits, `_`, `-`, spaces, `,` and `|` is an exact string or a `|`/`,`-separated list of exact strings; any other character makes it an unanchored JavaScript regular expression (RegExp.test).
matcher.title: Matcher

hooks.description: Hook handlers to run when the matcher applies; all matching handlers run in parallel and identical handlers from several settings files run once.
hooks.title: Hooks

hookEvent_InstructionsLoaded.title: InstructionsLoaded
hookEvent_InstructionsLoaded.description: When a CLAUDE.md or .claude/rules/*.md file is loaded into context (asynchronous, observability only).

hookMatcherGroup_InstructionsLoaded.description: Matcher group for InstructionsLoaded: an optional matcher plus the handlers to run when it applies. Handlers allowed here: command, http or mcp_tool (prompt and agent hooks are not supported on this event). The `if` field is not evaluated on this event, so a handler that sets it never runs.

matcher.description: Filters on the load reason. Values: `session_start`, `nested_traversal`, `path_glob_match`, `include`, `compact`. Evaluation: `*`, an empty string, or an omitted matcher matches everything; a value made only of letters, digits, `_`, `-`, spaces, `,` and `|` is an exact string or a `|`/`,`-separated list of exact strings; any other character makes it an unanchored JavaScript regular expression (RegExp.test).

hookEvent_SessionEnd.title: SessionEnd
hookEvent_SessionEnd.description: When a session terminates. Hooks share a 1.5 s budget unless a longer per-hook `timeout` is set (max 60 s).

hookMatcherGroup_SessionEnd.description: Matcher group for SessionEnd: an optional matcher plus the handlers to run when it applies. Handlers allowed here: command, http or mcp_tool (prompt and agent hooks are not supported on this event). The `if` field is not evaluated on this event, so a handler that sets it never runs.

matcher.description: Filters on why the session ended. Values: `clear`, `resume`, `logout`, `prompt_input_exit`, `other`. Evaluation: `*`, an empty string, or an omitted matcher matches everything; a value made only of letters, digits, `_`, `-`, spaces, `,` and `|` is an exact string or a `|`/`,`-separated list of exact strings; any other character makes it an unanchored JavaScript regular expression (RegExp.test). `bypass_permissions_disabled` was removed in v2.1.234; drop it from matchers.
